title: ALIMCO, Jaipur Foot, and the Bionic Gap in India's Artificial-Limb System

version_history.note: New post: India's artificial-limb system (ALIMCO, ADIP, BMVSS/Jaipur Foot, Artificial Limb Centre Pune) benchmarked against the verified global bionics/prosthetics company roster. Written per user request with an India-focused angle and independent re-verification of all facts (the initial request material cited only generic market-research aggregators). Includes one SVG chart (ADIP's Sept 2024 income-eligibility revision, +50% on both thresholds) and two comparison tables.
